messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: channel for Gripper v2. kickoff email went out this morning, three parts: PETG-CF jaw, aluminum horn adapter, lower current limit in firmware

messages.author: Samir Haddad
messages.text: I can help with the jaw geometry, the root fillet on v1 is tiny

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: yes please! 6 mm root and whatever fillet you think

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: I'll own the load testing, rig on bench 2

messages.author: Rosa Delgado
messages.text: any impact on the line for now?

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: nothing until the changeover, probably December

messages.author: Samir Haddad
messages.text: v2 jaw STLs in gripper_v2/cad, root is 6 mm with a 2 mm fillet

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: nice, printing two on the office printer in PLA for fit before we order PETG-CF

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: PLA test prints fit fine on the current servo, sending Abby the STLs

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: v1 jaws crack around 31 N. v2 PETG-CF hasn't broken at 60 N, the fixture tops out there 😂

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: BUT the plastic horn slips at ~40 N with the v2 jaw

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: figured. that's why the horn adapter is in scope

messages.author: Samir Haddad
messages.text: what's the failure mode on the horn? spline teeth shearing?

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: yeah, teeth on the plastic horn get rounded off, the servo output spline is fine

messages.author: Samir Haddad
messages.text: ok so the aluminum adapter makes total sense

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: 10 min stall test at current limit 230: servo case got to 52°C. at default it hit 71°C and smelled hot

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: good data. 230 is my front runner but I want the 8h hold before committing

messages.author: Priya Natarajan
messages.text: agree, 10 min isn't enough to say it won't drift up

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: Novak first articles arrived. 18/20 slide on nicely, 2 are tight on the spline

messages.text: tight is ok if they go on by hand without a mallet. if you need a mallet send them back to Gus

messages.text: not yet 🙈

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: ok

messages.author: Rosa Delgado
messages.text: for the W49 changeover, do the v2 grippers need a different calibration?

messages.author: Rosa Delgado

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: yes, it's on my list with the procedure wrist step

messages.author: Priya Natarajan
messages.text: for the current limit, are you going by servo temp or by grip force?

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: both. need enough force to hold ~1 kg with the v2 jaw, and the case under ~55C on a long hold

messages.author: Priya Natarajan
messages.text: makes sense

messages.author: Priya Natarajan
messages.text: do you want the backoff in the profile or in the teleop loop?

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: profile, so it works no matter what software the customer runs

messages.author: Priya Natarajan
messages.text: honest q, will #142 actually land before the 20th? no pressure, just planning

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: I want it to. if the hold test shows 230 is fine it's a one line change. if not I'll hand Jordan my notes

messages.author: Avery Brooks

messages.author: Daniel Okafor
messages.text: and let me know what you need from me for the handover

messages.author: Daniel Okafor
messages.text: how's the handover going? anything you're worried about?

messages.author: Avery Brooks
messages.text: mostly the stuff that only lives in my head. the monday recal, the wrist homing step, the horn torque, and Wei at Kaihong. I'm doing the knowledge capture thing this week to get it all recorded

messages.text: great, thank you
